title: Diagnostic Algorithm in Patients With Minor Head Injury
brief_summary: The objective of this prospective study is to evaluate the reliability of plain x-rays vs.cranial computed tomography as a screening method for skull fractures and its prognostic value for intracranial bleeding (ICB).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* head injury, nausea, vomiting

Exclusion Criteria:

* no head injury
study_population: Consecutive patients seen in the trauma outpatient area
